profile: Microbial ecologist and bioinformatics researcher with a Ph.D. in Ecology from the Research Center for Eco-Environmental Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences. I develop reproducible computational approaches for studying microbial interactions, with a focus on ecological networks, metagenomics, metabolic complementarity, and quorum sensing.

researchExperience.title: Q-SCOPE Development
researchExperience.place: RCEES, CAS & KU Leuven · Beijing, China & Leuven, Belgium
bullets: Developed Q-SCOPE (Quorum-Sensing Communication Link Predictor), a containerized web application that retains profile-level evidence, applies versioned component criteria to assign quorum-sensing sending and receiving potential, and predicts pathway-specific potential communication links.
Manuscript in submission: Q-SCOPE profiles quorum-sensing components and capabilities to predict potential communication links in microbial communities.

researchExperience.title: Metabolic Complementarity Network Modeling
researchExperience.place: Research Center for Eco-Environmental Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences · Beijing, China
bullets: Developed a metagenomics workflow combining co-occurrence and metabolic complementarity networks to identify microbial interactions in thermophilic communities.
Revealed that high temperatures strengthen metabolic cooperation, particularly between distantly related microbes and species with large differences in genome size.
The work resulted in first-author papers in Nature Communications and iMeta.

researchExperience.title: Scientific Training
researchExperience.place: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences & RCEES, CAS · Beijing, China
bullets: Completed foundational training in microbial ecology, molecular biology, bioinformatics, and biostatistics.
Participated in projects involving 16S rRNA gene sequencing, molecular ecological network analysis, and metagenomic sequencing data analysis.
